title: inventory
description: Missile inventory, it's used to understand what is total bumber of missiles and what are they ID's

cellNumber.description: This field is caclulated based on the array index of current missile (in missile array)

runtime.description: Indicates the total runtime of missile, initial number is 0, this is updated only via the launcher.

serialNum.description: Indicates missile serial number that is only available after turning the missile on. will be blank untill missile is turned on atleast 1 time.
